name: CurrentOrganization
body:
query CurrentOrganization {
  currentOrganization {
    cell
    canEdit
    canUpdate
    canRead
    canUpdate
    canUpdate
    createdAt
    discardedAt
    emailLogoUrl
    id
    live
    name
    nsfProtectionEnabled
    nsfProtectionFallbackEnabled
    path
    plaidIdentityEnabled
    ticker
    showPii
    scimEnabled
    simulateLiveSandboxData
    authorizePrebuiltUisWhitelabeling
    prebuiltUisWhitelabelingEnabled
    adminApprovalRuleEnabled
    adminApprovalRuleResources
    globalMfa
    organizationCustomization {
      id
      enabled
      emailReplyTo
      emailSignoff
      helpCenterLink
      primaryColor
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

body:
query calendarOpsHubView($id: String!) {
  calendar(id: $id) {
    id
    name
    workingDays

    needsRegularReview
    todayDate
    workingDayToday
    nextWorkingDays
    configIds

    __typename
